environment: Authenticated local Web workspace and real local PostgreSQL backend using synthetic recruiter data.

fixture.relationship_context: Founding Head of AI Infrastructure · Series C Search

visual_checks.mobile_scroll_note: A partially hidden scope row was reproduced only after the automation scrolled to the composer; a fresh page at scroll position zero placed the full scope row below both sticky headers.

direction_a.name: review-first evidence workbench
direction_a.strength: Exact evidence, atomic fact decisions, and separate action authority are immediately legible.
direction_a.weakness: The pre-contact intent and current relationship dependency appear only after a long verification sequence.

direction_b.name: scoped Chat first, governed contact page below
direction_b.rendered_reference: Current authenticated Web runtime captured during this evaluation.
direction_b.strength: The five-second question is clear: ask about this person in this relationship, then review one brief and one proposed next move.
direction_b.weakness: It must preserve one-click access to exact evidence and cannot expand into a generic conversational history.

structural_comparison.selection_reason: It matches the user's dominant entry behavior while retaining Direction A as the evidence, correction, approval, and history layer below the Chat response. The product remains ownable without the logo because person scope, governed references, proposal status, and the vermilion causal seam remain visible.
structural_comparison.accessibility_tradeoff: The Chat-first direction adds a large headline and composer above the review surface, but the 390-pixel run shows no horizontal overflow and keeps the action proposal visibly separate from execution.

assertions.claim: Chat is a scoped relationship intent surface rather than an unbound generic prompt.
The Web surface renders typed brief and proposal blocks from an immutable Wiki snapshot and context manifest.
The recruiter can explicitly reuse an existing person or create a separate same-name person before capture.
The bounded Chat-first surface has no horizontal overflow at 390 pixels and remains usable with a long mixed-script name and no verified photo.
Deleting the source removes the visible workspace, dependent knowledge, context manifests, and cached Wiki and Chat response bodies.

limits: This proves the current screenshot or transcript-backed synthetic slice, not resume, document, URL, browser-share, or iOS-share convergence.
The response is a deterministic brief projection rather than model-authored conversational synthesis.
The run does not establish recruiter time savings, repeat use, willingness to pay, or field trust.
